description: Create a Portkey integration for an external MCP server URL. For headers auth, provide custom_headers or a Secret Reference mapping targeting configurations.custom_headers; secret_mappings resolve protected values at runtime without storing them in the tool call. Organisation admin keys normally need workspace_id. After creation, create_mcp_server and configure capabilities/access; returns the integration id and slug.

auth_type.description: Authentication type. Current examples are 'none', 'headers' (custom headers), and 'oauth_auto' (OAuth); Portkey may accept additional values.

configurations.description: Additional documented or forward-compatible configuration fields. For headers auth, configurations.custom_headers is a string-to-string header map.

custom_headers.description: Custom headers for authentication (e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer xxx" }). Sent via configurations.custom_headers

name.description: Display name for the MCP integration

organisation_id.description: Organisation ID; required with an organisation admin API key when workspace_id is omitted

secret_mappings.description: Runtime Secret Reference mappings; every configurations.<field> target must be unique

secret_key.description: Optional key to select from a multi-value secret

secret_reference_id.description: Secret Reference UUID or slug accessible to this integration

target_field.description: Configuration field resolved at runtime, such as configurations.oauth_metadata

value_format.description: Use json when the target configuration field expects a structured object

tags.description: Key-value tags. Replaces existing tags; pass null to clear. Keys allow letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens

transport.description: MCP transport protocol: 'http' (streamable HTTP) or 'sse' (server-sent events)

url.description: URL endpoint of the MCP server to integrate

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID; set it to create the integration at workspace level. With an organisation admin key, give this or organisation_id.

name: create_mcp_integration
